searchText: Can I get some discussion on this https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/3577 I tagged people that reacted to this before, but I wonder what others think. This is not a hard-fork and would be simple to implement for us. Would want opinion from the forkchoice crowd as to the security of it and the general coredevs if you'd be in. If so I can draft a PR. Tagging <@291925846556540928> that may be a contrarian voice We had a couple fixes to add, `v1.14.0-rc.2` is now the recommended release for Deneb fork on Goerli next week. <@425572898787426305> I am a little lost as I do not follow the API repo, wasn't this supposed to be already agreed upon? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/388 it's a trivial boolean added to the payload, we can adapt heuristic later, every single client said that it was trivial to implement, I don't want to wait a hard fork for this Started writing a blog post since <@792822129019584562> requested some heuristics, and when I went there to look for the API link assuming it was already merged I found it's still open Ah is it this one? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/425

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
Can I get some discussion on this https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/3577
I tagged people that reacted to this before, but I wonder what others think. This is not a hard-fork and would be simple to implement for us. Would want opinion from the forkchoice crowd as to the security of it and the general coredevs if you'd be in. If so I can draft a PR. Tagging <@291925846556540928> that may be a contrarian voice

excerpts.author: philngo
excerpts.content: We had a couple fixes to add, `v1.14.0-rc.2` is now the recommended release for Deneb fork on Goerli next week.
